prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Desktop Pet Quick Reference Guide", "Learn how to summon, hide, and command your pet directly from your desktop system tray.", "Press shortcut key to toggle pet visibility", "Got It"]
1: ["Initializing desktop rendering engine and pet behavioral assets..."]
2: ["Connecting to authentication server and preparing account session..."]
3: ["Review Companion Traits", "Verify your pet companion's visual traits before generating your official certificate.", "Confirm & Proceed"]
4: ["Setup Desktop Pet Controls", "Practice calling and hiding your pet before entering your desktop environment.", "Test system tray menu and shortcut controls", "Finish Setup"]
5: ["Choose How You Want to Meet Your Companion", "You can quickly pick a ready starter pet or upload photos to craft a personalized companion.", "Continue to Choices"]
6: ["You will receive a notification as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop."]
7: ["For optimal pet rendering, upload sharp photos with bright background lighting and clear subjects."]
8: ["Your Pet is Active on Your Desktop!", "Click the system tray icon anytime to adjust pet behaviors, hide your companion, or trigger interaction options."]
9: ["Quick Sign In for Your Companion", "Create an account or sign in with one click to proceed to pet adoption seamlessly."]
